title: Very repetitive
content:
I’ve been playing this game since it dropped with the premium pass. It started at 5 stars because pull rates were reasonable for EXs / 1 stars and the battle concepts were so fresh. But since the B series everything has gotten repetitive and pull rates are horrendous, even with the premium pass. Premium pass also doesn’t get you much, just 2 extra packs a day (with equally bad pull rates), and the premium promos are a joke (maybe created by an intern). The hour glass generation is terrible so don’t expect to rip more packs without paying for gold or waiting weeks to save up enough for a 10 pack rip (not guaranteed 2 star or immersive from the 10 pack rip). And the shine dust trade mechanic is also terrible. You have to either save up shine dust or grind out promo battles for days to get enough shine dust for trades. Also if you’re trying to complete secret emblems you can’t trade immersive rares or gold cards to complete the secret emblems. 

It’ll be fun for maybe a couple months as a new player but it will get old fast….

author: MineBM
title: Prepare for Disappointment
content:
Pull rates are bad with a non-existent pity system. Wonder picks just raise your hopes up before crashing them back down to earth. Battling just isn’t very fun; the game’s competitive mode is a joke with no penalty for losing, the missions for playing random battles are tedious for lackluster rewards. Similarly, step-up battles only provide meaningful rewards for doing the first step, removing all incentive for doing the rest. Aside from those 5 things I listed, there is literally nothing else to do or keep you invested aside from the dopamine rush of opening two packs a day; and even that gets old when you go 30 packs aka 2 weeks without a pull to be excited for.

With the world of Pokémon being as vast and flush with story, characters, locations, and factions; it’s insane that the dev team can’t come up with a rudimentary story mode that pits you against trainers, rivals, team bosses, etc. with the simple goal of being the best tcg player. Release a new chapter every month that feature unique battles with opponents using cards across multiple expansions, and dish out meaningful rewards like alternative full-art cards, badges, and packs/hourglasses. Additionally, give us a real event/set of missions that isn’t just “do 10 wonder picks” or “do this same battle 10 times”. Instead, how about missions that ask us to use specific pokemon combinations, or events that have us pick between two factions (Aqua and Magma for instance) where we contribute points to either side depending on the battles we win and the pokemon we use.

Just, give us something that makes the game feel more lively and less rigid. Right now, the entire game feels like it’s contained within the four sterile walls of a pokemon center, with the closest thing we’ve had to seeing the outside world being the Team Rocket event which introduced a hidden shop. GIVE US MORE OF THAT! I really hope the new anime inspires this team to give us more because there is a lot of potential here, someone just needs to realize it.

title: Rigged AI for the sake of making money
content: I really hope this review reaches someone. This game can be fun, but it gets ruined for you when you find out the game intentionally rigs the odds against you in both CPU battles and PVP. I have had deck shuffles that put me in the worst position possible and repeat itself over the course of multiple games, making it over a 1 in 4.8 BILLION CHANCE of doing so. Love pokemon, hate having no control whatsoever on winning. Do not download and definitely do not spend ANY money. These moron developers think that we, as the consumer, want to get absolutely cooked by AI. Like seriously, test it out yourself. Go into a computer battle using a deck that would benefit you to go first. Watch as you will flip tails and go second 10+ times in a row. Switch to a deck that will benefit you to go second, and watch as you flip 10+ times and go first every time. If by some mathematical miracle you get the desired starting position, witness the AI pull the exact cards you need and flip the exact number of heads they need every. Single. Time. It’s not worth it. Stay away from this game unless you’re just looking to open packs for fun, do not spend your money or waste your time. Shame on the developers, shame on DeNa, and shame on Nintendo.

author: Gabepimentel
title: Game is fun initially
content:
1) it’s called Pokemon TRADING CARD Game, but trading costs way to much to be able to do it more than a handful of times. And after you spent all your shinedust, there is no way to grind it back without buying/opening hundreds of packs hoping to get duplicates for the small amount of dust, which is why it requires hundreds just to do a couple 2* trades and above. Insane decision and a huge shame for people who want to collect and trade EXs, art cards, build new decks, etc. 
2) after solo battles/missions are done, you have nothing to play to grind pack hourglasses AND shinedust. So once you finish the solo content, which the rewards aren’t a lot and the content isn’t either, there is nothing to play besides ranked battles. There needs to be so much more to do in the game besides ranked and occasional events. 

3) it’s a digital game and I think the idea is to keep people engaged and playing. Most of the game feels it is designed with the idea, lets get people to buy packs, just to scratch their pokemon pack opening itch, which I don’t have, and everything else is just designed enough to say they have options but everything points to once the solo content is done, you really do not have options other than to wait for events that give you a LITTLE bit more, or buy packs where duplicates are abhorrent. I just want to play a card game and pokemon I know from my childhood.

Final) this game could probably be the best card game if they want, I can see it after playing many digital/physical games, they should be adding way more solo/multiplayer content like gym battles, far better costs to trading, rotations, arguably a re-design of how you receive cards or deal with duplicates, etc etc. hearthstone has a good system in this regard. They realized if they want to keep players, they had to make sure players can get all the new cards, and duplicates, only come after you complete a set, so it’s harder to fall behind. 

I don’t think the developers have much excuses because this isn’t the first digital card game, so I am giving a lower rating because these are all conscious decisions made. But it is fun gameplay wise. Unfortunate about everything outside of the gameplay

author: guccisgooch
title: So Much Wasted Potential
content:
There’s an extremely fun game hidden in here somewhere. The new cards and set drops are always exciting. The original artworks are stunning along with some fun mechanics not found in the original TCG. However, outside of that, the game does nothing to incentivize you to actually log on in play. Battling is completely unrewarding. Pull rates are absolutely abysmal. Missions feel bare bones and rarely worth it. You don’t even get rewarded for the main aspect of the game, which is COLLECTING CARDS. 

Battling is a toxic cesspool of imbalance and RNG. And like I said, YOU GET NO REWARDS FOR THIS, aside from some hourglasses ONCE A MONTH. 90% of cards in an expansion are unplayable/filler. Decks are limited to 20 cards, which hard caps deck creativity. This in turn, impacts how exciting it is to play with new cards, since you don’t have the deck space to combine them with previously released cards that may combo in a fun way. 

The developers just seem very contempt with not improving or adding anything to incentivize and reward players in any real ways. I’ve spent a good amount of money on this game, and I’ve felt little to no benefit from it aside from being able to open a few more packs than usual. The emphasis of this game is more on cosmetics and aesthetics vs actual in game substance. 

It’s such a shame, because it really feels like this game could be the perfect reset/getaway for players tired of the original TCG power creep and price tag. It genuinely feels like I get slapped in the face every-time I open this app and attempt to play. 

Please do something. This game has too much potential to just be another mobile Pokemon throw away in 4-5 years.

The moment I switched to a different deck, that Pokémon suddenly appeared in the AI’s opening hand and Active Spot repeatedly—and it was the exact Pokémon that countered the deck I had been using.
